caption: The video captures a monochrome close view of a shallow metal plate resting on a stone windowsill beside a window. A translucent dome-shaped object sits on the right side of the plate, with bright reflections on the metal surface and a streaked wall and frame behind it. The object holds a rounded mound in view, and its surface catches light along the upper curve. Throughout the sequence the dome largely keeps its overall height and broad silhouette, with only subtle shifts in its surface sheen rather than any clear flattening or spreading. A small bright spot on the lower front surface grows less distinct and merges with the surrounding glossy area. The highlights and reflections on the dome shift subtly, while the plate remains level and fixed. The background and window frame stay essentially unchanged, keeping the view quiet except for these gentle surface changes.
relations: The translucent dome resting on the metal plate maintains its rounded mound shape and overall height.
Subtle shifts in surface sheen cause highlights and reflections on the dome to move gently.
A small bright spot on the dome's lower front surface gradually merges with the surrounding glossy area.
The metal plate remains level on the stone windowsill, keeping the background and window frame fixed.
